thread:
maria: Pushing the final blog draft for tomorrow's launch. Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/drafts/launch-post-v10 — please give final thumbs by 3pm PT. Main open items: CTA wording, webinar registration routing, benchmark callout (latency/cost), and hero quote. @oliver @tess @rajesh
alex: Read through — looks tight. CTA options below, prefer 2. Small tweak on first paragraph for clarity.
oliver: Quick mock updated here: https://figma.com/file/SCHEMATIC — hero image and CTA button look good. prefer CTA A visually.
rajesh: For lead routing, we should send enterprise leads (>5 seats) to AE queue, others to webinar nurture. I'll add tags: `lead_size=enterprise|product` and `source=launch-blog`.
tess: Legal quick pass — claims look ok but need source for "30% lower per-token cost" claim. Please add benchmark link or hedge language ("up to 30%" or "mean observed").
alex: Good catch. I'll change to "up to 30% lower per-token costs in our benchmark (link)". Where should the benchmark link point? draft GH or internal S3?
maria: Put it in the public blog as a footnote linking to our benchmark appendix (S3). I'll add a short slug. @tess ok with that?
tess: Fine if appendix has raw data and method, and we say "internal benchmark" not implying third-party. Also add cookie consent mention for tracking UTMs.
alex: CTA variants: 1) "Try Redwood Optimize" 2) "See the benchmark + demo" 3) "Get early access" — my vote 2. UTM params: `?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=launch&utm_medium=cta`
oliver: Design prefers shorter: "See the benchmark" (button). Works with mobile.
maria: Agree — final CTA: "See the benchmark + demo". Rajesh, can you confirm routing and tags? Also need webinar seatmap link and HubSpot form ID.
rajesh: Confirmed. AE route for enterprise leads, webinar nurture for others. HubSpot form ID `hs_form_8234`. I'll add mapping in the publish checklist.
deploy-bot: publish-checklist: scheduled publish 2024-05-15T17:00:00Z, lock assets by 15:00 PT.
alex: I'll push final copy to the shared draft and flag for prod publish. Tagging for final sign-off @maria @tess @oliver.
maria: Thanks team — if I don't get objections by 15:00 PT I'll move to publish. :thumbsup:
